keys.name: OFFSET_READY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left-biased guard opens a negative-space wedge; pelvis already off-center
keys.causal_role: establish asymmetrical defensive readiness without neutral symmetry

keys.name: GUARD_COLUMN_BRACE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: guard endpoint reaches its working line before contact; pelvis sinks and stays behind it
keys.causal_role: make anticipation live in COM and torso, not arm reach

keys.name: PRECONTACT_STILL_POINT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: guard endpoint stays fixed while threat closes; COM drops another cell
keys.causal_role: separate guard placement from actual contact

keys.name: IMPACT_LOCK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: same guard endpoint takes impact while head and pelvis displace right/down
keys.causal_role: contact is a constraint, not a farthest-reach pose

keys.name: PINNED_BODY_SHEAR
keys.motion_arc_root_note: guard point remains pinned while pelvis outruns the shoulder line and left heel unloads
keys.causal_role: show force transfer behind the fixed defensive endpoint

keys.name: REAR_POST_BREAK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left support breaks; rear foot alone owns the still-rising torque debt
keys.causal_role: make support loss visible before recovery can begin

keys.name: CONTACT_RELEASE_FOLD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact releases but the guard folds inward; pelvis does not spring back
keys.causal_role: preserve recoil consequence after the external constraint disappears

keys.name: KNEE_SEEK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: free knee dives toward the floor while rear foot stays the only support
keys.causal_role: pay vertical debt before taking new height

keys.name: KNEE_POST_ACQUIRE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left knee drops decisively to floor while rear foot widens right; free lower leg folds high, making the body-floor post unmistakable
keys.causal_role: create a visibly low body-floor support topology distinct from tool-floor support

keys.name: LOW_TORQUE_SPILL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: knee and rear foot stay pinned wide while chest/head rotate right and the free lower leg kicks up/back, opening a low triangular negative space
keys.causal_role: turn impact debt into unmistakable low rotational travel around two body supports

keys.name: KNEE_POST_PUSH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: body rises one authored stage while knee and rear foot remain pinned; pelvis countercoils before knee release
keys.causal_role: make the low post visibly generate the coming corkscrew rather than teleporting height on release

keys.name: KNEE_RELEASE_CORKSCREW
keys.motion_arc_root_note: knee lifts only after the low tripod has visibly spent torque; head and guard climb opposite the still-pinned rear foot
keys.causal_role: earn height recovery through support release and corkscrew counter-travel

keys.name: AROUND_PREPLANT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: released leg reaches around the rear post into an open landing slot
keys.causal_role: author a preplant instead of interpolating directly into support

keys.name: NEW_FOOT_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new foot catches after the around-step; pelvis compresses below the guard line
keys.causal_role: make reacquisition trustworthy before the body re-stacks

keys.name: CATCH_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: lead plant stays fixed while torso/guard continue past it and rear leg trails free
keys.causal_role: spend rotational momentum after the catch rather than reversing into pose

keys.name: SECOND_FOOT_REACQUIRE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: rear foot returns only after the overshoot; pelvis counter-rotates under wide guard
keys.causal_role: restore a two-support base after, not before, momentum is paid

keys.name: LATE_GUARD_REOPEN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: guard reopens late on the original side while head lags the pelvis counter-rotation
keys.causal_role: restore defensive authority without erasing the crooked recovery silhouette

keys.name: SECONDARY_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: arms/head settle around a pelvis that remains displaced and turned
keys.causal_role: retain secondary lag and visible recovery debt

keys.name: DISPLACED_READY_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: rear foot already peels for the next action; root never returns to its original stack
keys.causal_role: finish with movement debt rather than idle reset
